items.comment: Accurate and matches the established pattern from AbstractFunction17. Minor style nit: the second sentence is slightly redundant ('Extending this class allows a function value to be defined by extending a class rather than...') — repeats 'extending a class' within one sentence, unlike the smoother single-sentence phrasing used in AbstractFunction1 ('...allowing a function value to be defined by extending a class rather than the trait'). Not a blocker since it's consistent with the sibling AbstractFunction17 doc already written in this batch.
Type parameter descriptions are accurate and match the corresponding Function18 trait's tparam docs (T1..T18 as argument types, R as return type).
